relationships.subject: nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: In mice, nociceptor ablation reduced pain, monocyte recruitment, and lesion size

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, CGRP changed the phenotype of macrophages to a pro-endometriosis phenotype.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP-stimulated macrophages demonstrated impaired efferocytosis and supported increased endometrial cell growth in a RAMP1-dependent manner

relationships.subject: CGRP/RAMP1 signaling
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment of lesion-bearing mice with US Food and Drug Administration-approved drugs that block CGRP-RAMP1 signaling reduced mechanical hyperalgesia, spontaneous pain, and lesion size.

key_findings: Nociceptor ablation reduced pain, monocyte recruitment and lesion size in mouse endometriosis
CGRP skews macrophages to a pro-endometriosis, efferocytosis-impaired phenotype via RAMP1; CGRP-RAMP1 blockade reduced hyperalgesia and lesion size
